title: Hearty Midnight Cravings French Sausages Tagine
description: A rich, roasted French dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, served in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Season the sausages with salt and pepper, and brown in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Transfer the browned sausages to the clay tajine vessel, reserving the juices.
In the same skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the chopped parsley, olive oil, coconut milk, chicken broth, chopped dried figs, and fennel seeds (if using) to the skillet.
Stir the mixture to combine, then pour it over the browned sausages in the tajine vessel.
Cover the tajine vessel with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tajine vessel from the oven, and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the Hearty Midnight Cravings French Sausages Tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
